---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature, data layer, or improvement.
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## What do you want?

A clear description of the feature or improvement.

## Why does it matter?

What problem does this solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed implementation

If you have an idea of how it should work, describe it. Sketches, links to
similar tools, or data source suggestions are all welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about?

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — screenshots, mockups, related issues.
